title: Build the BGP Underlay
summary: Configure a 2-spine / 4-leaf CLOS fabric from scratch via the in-browser console. Learn shared-AS spines, per-leaf ASNs, ECMP with multipath-relax, peer-groups, fast BGP timers — and why each choice matters for AI workloads.
learning_objectives: Fast BGP timers (3s/9s) for training-job continuity

title: Inject a Link Failure
summary: Take down a fabric link, watch BGP reconverge under fast timers, observe ECMP shrink from 2 to 1 path, and trace how training-job traffic stays alive across the failure.

title: AllReduce Traffic Patterns
summary: Run a Gloo-backed AllReduce across all 8 workers. Visualize how the synchronous east-west burst loads the fabric, and see what happens when you increase tensor size.

title: NCCL Collective Emulation
summary: Simulate NCCL communication patterns (AllReduce, Broadcast, AllGather, ReduceScatter) and see how each one stresses the fabric differently. Pick a pattern, pick a topology shape, watch the flows.
